audit.whatIsWrong: Full read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Zed/Skill/Zed against content's Karma/Karma/Skill/Skill/Karma/Zed/Karma — five rows disagreed, and packet.defects flagged that the chart gave Karma 4 of 7 stages in a matchup she wins 44.09%.
audit.why: Razor Shuriken reaches 900 to Inner Flame's 950 and Living Shadow is not up at level 1, so rows 0-1 are Karma's. Death Mark at 120s owns level 6 — which mid and spikes[1] already argue — and his lethality item owns the next row. Late, Karma's peel out-values a single-target assassin, which whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all argue.
audit.corrected: Settled as Karma/Karma/Skill/Skill/Zed/Zed/Karma in both layers: full rows 0,1 to Karma, row 5 to Zed, row 6 to Karma; content win[4] Karma -> Zed to agree with the full layer and with its own prose. Karma now holds 3 of 7, which also clears the packet defect.
sources: enemyKit Q range 900, W cd 20/19/18/17/16, R cd 120/110/100

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 why said 'no new ult — your 6 is a Mantra rank' and never stated what Death Mark does; whys[4] hedged with 'but Karma still holds lane priority overall' while the row was scored for Karma.
audit.why: Death Mark is 120/110/100s: an untargetable dash in, a mark, and a repeat of a portion of all damage dealt 3 seconds later. That is the spike, and it is his.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and whys[4] both now state the 120s cooldown and the 3-second repeat, and the row reads Zed on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly wrote 'W tether stun' and 'Q-E poke' — Karma's W roots, and her E is a shield with no damage. breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Riot's text: Focused Resolve tethers, reveals and roots; Inspiration shields and speeds. The decisive sequencing fact is that Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1 against a flat 12s tether — he baits the tether with the shadow and swaps, so the W belongs to the return, not the opening shuriken.
audit.corrected: Fabricated stun and poke-E removed; breakdown.cooldowns now carries Death Mark 120s/100s and the 3-second repeat, Living Shadow 20s, Shadow Slash 5s, Razor Shuriken 6s at 75 energy.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood under 'RE + W the dive package'; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad under 'Shove past river with E down' (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The dive bullet is about shielding before the mark repeats at 3 seconds; the river bullet is about Living Shadow's flank angle.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their titles.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 favor Karma cleanly: your Q-E poke chips Zed for free damage he can't answer without shadow-stepping into your W tether range, and he lacks the level to commit fully to trades. He's forced into a farm-only pattern with his Q, since anything more aggressive risks getting stunned and poked down further. By levels 4-5 it becomes a genuine skill matchup — Zed starts threatening short trades with Q-W combos and baiting your W tether before diving, so both sides are now punished hard for misplays rather than one side dominating.
